title: Polyamine Modulation in Drinking Water
author: Ana Catarina Carapinha Cascalho
materials: Weigh the right amount of DFMO.

Spermine tetrahydrochloride; (Thermo Scientific; J63060; CAS: 306-67-2; MW: 348.18 g/mol) (Spermine) Spermidine trihydrochloride (Thermo Scientific; 215100250; CAS: 334-50-9; MW: 254.63 g/mol) (Spermidine)

steps.title: Prepare DFMO Drinking Water
steps.instruction: Prepare DFMO drinking water at a working concentration of 2 Mass / % volume (20 g / 1 L).

substeps.instruction: Retrieve DFMO (CAS:96020-91-6) from -20 °C stock.
Weigh 20 g of DFMO and dissolve it in 1 L of water.
Mix by gently inverting and wait for the substance to dissolve.
Filter the drinking water through a 0.20 µm filter unit (Fisher Scientific; 15933307).
Store the drinking water at 4 °C.

steps.title: Initiate Animal Treatment
steps.instruction: On Day 21, wean and separate male and female pups (avoid single mice to prevent stress/anxiety) and move them to the compound drinking water delivery.

substeps.instruction: Weight drinking bottles to monitor water consumption.
Attach a clear card and note to the bottle to ensure animal caretakers do not change the water.

steps.title: Prepare Spermidine/Spermine Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a 0.75 Molarity (M) stock solution of Spermidine Trihydrochloride (MW = 254.63 g/mol) or Spermine.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve pure powder stocks from 4 °C storage.
Weigh the necessary amount of substance using a precision scale in an appropriate recipient.
Seal the container with parafilm.
Record the opening date (if new), Ref#, and Lot# in the lab book.
Add the calculated volume of solvent using a pro-pipettor to reach 0.75 M.
Mix by gently inverting and wait for the substance to dissolve.
Filter the solution into a fresh labeled falcon tube using a 0.22 µm filter (Carl Roth; SE2M035I07) connected to a syringe.

steps.title: Aliquot and Stabilize Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Aliquot the stock solution into labeled tubes and protect from degradation using nitrogen.

substeps.instruction: Label aliquoting tubes with the name, concentration (e.g., Spermidine or spermine 25 mg/ml; 10X stock), date of preparation, and technician name.
Aliquot the solution: 400 µL per aliquot for preweaning treatment, or 4 mL per aliquot for postweaning treatments.
Place any leftover volume into a separate tube and clearly label the specific volume.

Under a hood, replace the air in each tube with a nitrogen atmosphere: open the lid, place the pipette tip on the side without touching the liquid, wait for 10 seconds, and quickly close the cap. Repeat for all aliquots.
Transfer aliquots to a box at -20 °C (stable for up to 3 months).

steps.title: Final Documentation and Water Preparation
steps.instruction: Complete lab records and prepare the final drinking water for mice.

substeps.instruction: Verify that all information in the template stock preparation is filled in the lab book.
Dilute the 0.75 M stock 1:250 (4 mL stock in 1 L tap water) to prepare drinking water.
Filter the drinking water through a 0.20 µm filter unit.
Store the drinking water at 4 °C and renew bottles every 2 weeks.
